targetText: It is this mistake that quite justly earns for the romanticist the designation of reactionary, although this term is not used to indicate a desire simply to restore medieval institutions, but the attempt to measure the new society with the old patriarchal yardstick, the desire to find a model in the old order and traditions, which are totally unsuited to the changed economic conditions.
summary: Lenin defines the reactionary essence of economic romanticism: not necessarily wanting to reinstate feudalism, but attempting to judge and reform modern capitalism using the obsolete yardstick of small patriarchal production.
